svg.aria-label: Two-dimensional reconstruction of Ungewitter figure 1236, clipped to supplied source extent
svg.title: Ungewitter figure 1236: measured central quatrefoil and source-limited window tracery
svg.desc: Black curves include 8 V08 ink-fitted quatrefoil arcs and provisional manually interpreted lower and frame curves. Pale gray dashed guides are analytical axes. Provisional contours are not validated geometric constructions. Source pixel coordinates, not architectural dimensions.

g.aria-label: Manually placed source-looking contours not geometrically validated
Provisional lettering locations, redrawn rather than original ink
